name: Bloodchief Ascension
oracle_text:
At the beginning of each end step, if an opponent lost 2 or more life this turn, you may put a quest counter on Bloodchief Ascension.
Enchantments you control have "Whenever a card is put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, that player loses 2 life."

audit.notes: M5 mill/graveyard feedback slice; end-step quest counter proof-irrelevant.
